continuous_text.title: The Robot Song
continuous_text.content:
Can you sing?
Yes, I can. Yes, I can.
Can you sing?
Yes, I can. Yes, I can.
Sing this song with me.

Can you run?
Can you catch?
Yes, I can. Yes, I can.
Can you fly?
No, I can't. But I can jump high!
continuous_text.notes: Audio tracks 060 and 061. Includes substitution action words: talk, dance, swim.

continuous_text.title: Let's Catch the Moon!
continuous_text.content:
Frame 1
Narrator: Here's Jing. Here's the moon.
Jing: Let's catch the moon!
Friend: You can't catch the moon, Jing!
Jing: Yes, I can!

Frame 2
Jing: I can climb! But I can't catch the moon.

Frame 3
Jing: I can jump! But I can't catch the moon.

Frame 4
Mom: What is it?
Jing: It's a plane.

Frame 5
Friend: Can you fly?
Jing: No, I can't.

Frame 6
Narrator: Jing is sad.
Mom: Look at the moon!
Jing: But I can't swim.

Frame 7
Narrator: Jing has an idea.
Jing: I have water.

Frame 8
Narrator: The moon is in the water.
Jing: Look! I can catch the moon!
continuous_text.notes: Lesson 4 Story spanning pages 38 and 39. Demonstrates perseverance in problem-solving.

continuous_text.title: Free time activities in Japan
continuous_text.content:
Hi Evie,
How are you?
Here are two photos of my free time activities.
Can you play basketball? It's my favorite activity. This is my basketball team. I'm number nine.
I can't play tennis, but I can swim. I can sled with my family, too.
Can you ski? I can't ski, but I can make a snowman!
Hana
continuous_text.notes: Lesson 5 Reading passage formatted as an email to Evie.
